properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Blake2b (224/256-bit digests) is Cardano's workhorse hash: transaction/block header hashes, script and auxiliary-data hashes, Ed25519 public-key hashing for address credentials, and the legacy Byron address derivation (sha3_then_blake2b224). Not quantum-urgent (Grover only halves preimage resistance); digest sizes are fixed by the on-chain formats.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Sha3_256 is used for the legacy Byron-era address derivation (sha3_then_blake2b224) and is offered as a general digest type by the chain_crypto module. Quantum-safe digest; kept for on-chain format compatibility.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 derivations, both with low iteration counts: EMIP-003 password encryption (19,162 iterations, 32-byte salt, 32-byte ChaCha20-Poly1305 key) for wallet data, and from_bip39_entropy (4,096 iterations, password as salt) turning BIP-39 entropy into an ed25519-bip32 root XPrv.
